prompt: A shop offers 'buy now, pay later': take the item home today and pay in instalments over the next few weeks. What is the most important thing to check before agreeing?

options.text: Whether the shop has the item in your favourite colour
What happens if a payment is late — fees and total cost
Whether your friends also use it
How quickly you can get the item home

explanation: Buy now, pay later can be interest-free if every instalment is paid on time, but missed payments can bring late fees and affect your credit record — so the late-payment terms, not the item, are what need reading first.
